sections.heading: Market trends 2026: what clients can't do alone with design systems + AI
sections.text: *Researched 20 Oct 2026.* Labels: D = documented by a vendor, the press or an expert, not verified by us · I = our inference. LinkedIn can't be searched directly, so expert views come from their talks, newsletters, blogs and courses. On the board, this content is the zones *Market 2026*, *Experts are saying*, *Why clients need us*, *Commodity*, *What we sell* and *Sources and files* in Product scoping.

sections.heading: The one-line insight
Trend radar
sections.text:
# · Trend · What's happening · Needs us, or DIY?

1 · Every tool wants its own format · Figma Specs: a Markdown design-rules editor for people + agents, open beta, Config India 15 Oct (D). Figma Make guidelines/ (D). Claude Design imports design systems from GitHub or design files and checks output against them, Jun (D). Google Stitch DESIGN.md, open source, Apr (D). Storybook 10.3 MCP + manifests, React only, Mar (D). Chromatic-hosted MCP (D). v0 / shadcn registries (D). AGENTS.md, skills, llms.txt; Mitsubishi Electric's Serendie ships its design system as a Claude Code plugin (D). DTCG 2025.10 stable (D) · Installing one: DIY. Keeping 8+ in sync from one source: needs us (I)
2 · Context beats probability · Into Design Systems 2026 talks: "design systems as AI infrastructure". Agents need intent, usage and anti-patterns as data, not prose (D) · Docs site: DIY. Machine-readable intent: needs us
3 · Agentic design systems · Self-healing loop observe → detect → suggest → fix → learn (Kavcic). Trust in stages, per action. GitHub agentic workflows' "safe outputs". Figma Agent out of beta: audits, migrations, bulk fixes (D). Supernova Editor MCP, agent writes (D) · Figma Agent features: DIY. Trust levels and governance: needs us
4 · Evals · Spotify Encore scores AI output against the system across LLMs and MCP tools (D). CHI 2026: a registry approach reached 95.08% compliance on 6 UIs, a small study (D). No standard benchmark exists (D) · Lint plugins: DIY. A per-client eval: needs us
5 · Generative UI · Google A2UI v0.9: agents pick from an allow-listed component catalog. MCP Apps render UI inside Claude, ChatGPT, VS Code (D). NN/g writes on GenUI vs vibe coding (D) · MCP Apps hosting: DIY. An agent-safe component catalog: needs us
6 · Designers ship code · Figma 2026 AI Report: devs doing design 44% → 60%; designers in code 21% → 41% (D). Cursor 3 Design Mode, Apr (D). Vibe coding bypasses tokens and a11y (D) · Tools: DIY. Stopping drift with tokens + gates: needs us
7 · Figma CLIs and agent tooling · No official Figma CLI found. The official path is MCP + use_figma + skills + Code Connect (D). Community CLIs: figma-use, figctl, figma-cli (DESIGN.md → variables), figma-agent-cli; some rely on desktop debugging that newer Figma blocks (D). Southleft figma-console-mcp v1.34 (D) · Trying one: DIY. A vetted, client-specific toolchain: needs us. Echoes the Audit's "Personalized CLI (?)"
8 · The capacity gap · zeroheight 2026: 56% of DS teams use AI, 15% say it meets the hype, 61% lack people (D). Figma 2026: only 36% of organisations adopt "unified"; the rest lag (D). Figma AI-native guide: "no clear playbook" (D) · The core reason they buy help (I)

sections.heading: Experts are saying
sections.text:
Who · Where · Claim (paraphrased)

Brad Frost + TJ Pitre (Southleft) · IDS 2026 talk "AI Without the Chaos"; Brad's AI & DS course with audit skills · Context-based design systems tame AI output; score components (FigmaLint)
Romina Kavcic · IDS 2026 "Agentic Design Systems" · Observe, detect, suggest, fix, learn; encode intent, not values
Diana Wolosin (Indeed) · IDS 2026; Design Systems Collective · JSON metadata for MCP, Markdown for instructions; MCP solves retrieval, not quality
Jan Six (GitHub) · IDS 2026 · Agents hallucinate what they can't see; semantic names; sub-agent reviewers
Jesse Gardner (NY State) · IDS 2026 "Context > Probability" · Design systems are AI infrastructure
Nathan Curtis · Smashing Amsterdam 2026 · Components as data: a platform-agnostic spec as source of truth, versioned by tools
Spotify Encore team · IDS meetup · Eval framework compares generated components with the system
Cristian Morales (Enara Health) · IDS 2026 · Encode governance; detect drift automatically

How they back our proposal:
- Curtis's "components as data" and the "context > probability" talks are the closest precedent for our system contract.
- The governance talks (trust in stages, safe outputs) are precedent for review before merge.

sections.heading: What clients can't do alone → what we sell
What this changes in the 20 Oct proposal
sections.text:
- Same direction: one service and one experience, not one codebase.
- Two modules added next to the control panel:
  - a channel publisher (contract → each agent format);
  - evals next to the CI checks.
- One new spike: the generative-UI catalog.
- Pressure on pure tooling grows. Figma Specs/Agent and Claude Design import are moving into "manage the system with AI". Sell outcomes, governance and the clean-up, not the panel alone.
